items.title: CVS Health (CVS) Stock May Be Undervalued Despite Oncology Authorization Expansion
items.summary: CVS Health has delivered a 36.9% share price gain over the past three years, even after a recent pullback. This puts fresh focus on whether that climb still lines up with what the business earns. With earnings in the spotlight and the stock giving back some ground in recent weeks, the key issue for you is whether today's valuation is properly grounded in its profit power. items.title: Can UNH Stock Keep Growing Earnings While Its Sales Stall?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) has turned its profits around. Operating earnings rose 55% in the second quarter of 2026, and management raised its full-year adjusted earnings guide to $19.50 to $20 a share. Revenue, though, has nearly stopped growing. So the rest of the recovery rests on something the company only partly controls: the medical bills of the people it insures.
